title: Housing Association
summary: Adds value streams — Find & Move In, Live & Sustain, and Support & Improve — grouping v1 capabilities by the outcome tenants experience.
sourceDescription: Starter capability map for a housing association, v2: adds value streams (ADR-023) — Find & Move In, Live & Sustain, Support & Improve — grouping v1 capabilities by the outcome tenants experience. Capability items are unchanged from v1 (codes 1-12). Stream content was drafted this sprint (F6) for the reviewer; reviewed by Simon Parkinson, 2026-09-21.

sources.citation: HACT UK Housing Data Standards (consulted for sector vocabulary; not copied)
Regulator of Social Housing consumer and economic standards, and the Scottish Social Housing Charter (regulatory duties consulted for sector-specific capabilities)
UK Government Functional Standards GovS 001-016 (consulted for the shared corporate capabilities)

valueStreams.name: Find & Move In
valueStreams.description: Starts when someone applies for a home. Ends when they have signed up and the previous home is ready to let again.

valueStreams.name: Live & Sustain
valueStreams.description: Starts when a tenancy begins. Ends with rent managed, repairs done and the home kept safe.

valueStreams.name: Support & Improve
valueStreams.description: Starts when a tenant needs help or support. Ends when it is resolved and the community is better for it.
